title: Discipline Lead
purpose: Accountable for the design quality, completeness, and consistency of discipline-specific BIM content and documentation outputs. Represents discipline authority for documentation outcomes derived from BIM, ensuring discipline models are fit for drawings, sheets, and delivery at agreed milestones.
authority_statements: Approve or reject discipline BIM states for use in coordination and documentation milestones
Approve discipline-level responses to BIM coordination issues
Direct modeling priorities and sequence within discipline authoring teams
Exercise authority within discipline scope and within constraints of enterprise standards and project BEP
May reject model changes that conflict with discipline design intent or standards
May not override BIM governance rules, CDE protocols, or BEP requirements
May not define enterprise BIM standards or manage cross-discipline workflows
Does not hold contractual acceptance authority on behalf of project or client
responsibilities: Own quality and completeness of discipline's BIM and documentation outputs
Ensure discipline participation in BIM workflows, reviews, and coordination
Align discipline resources with BIM tasks defined in TIDPs
Formally approve discipline models for documentation use before inclusion in coordinated or issued sets
Review discipline-relevant BIM data using externalized CSV/Excel monitoring outputs
Confirm discipline data completeness to the level required for the active phase
accountabilities: Suitability of discipline BIM content for reliable and consistent documentation outputs
Preservation of discipline design intent across coordination cycles
Timely delivery of discipline information deliverables committed in TIDP
approvals: Discipline BIM models and documentation packages for milestone issue
Discipline coordination responses and model modifications
inputs: Project BEP and Information Requirements from Project BIM Manager
Coordination issues and clash reports from Project BIM Coordinator
Authored model content from BIM Modelers and Model Authors
outputs: Discipline drawing sets, schedules, and specifications
